definition: Dolophine is methadone hydrochloride, a synthetic opioid drug that acts on brain and nervous system opioid receptors in ways similar to morphine. It can produce pain relief as well as effects such as euphoria, sedation, slowed breathing, pinpoint pupils, slowed heart rate, and physical dependence; compared with heroin, withdrawal tends to start more slowly, last longer, and be less severe.
